# Note Vault: Offline AI for Docs

🧠 **Your Documents. Your Device. Your Intelligence.**

Note Vault is a private AI document assistant that lets you chat with PDFs and documents directly on your phone.

Ask questions, search files, and understand long documents faster using on-device AI.

**No cloud. No accounts. No data uploads.**

Your AI runs locally on your device, giving you private access to your knowledge without depending on cloud AI services.

## Chat With Your PDFs Using AI

Turn static documents into an interactive knowledge assistant. Instead of scrolling through hundreds of pages, simply ask questions and get answers based on your files.

With Note Vault, you can:

- Chat with PDF files
- Ask questions about your documents
- Summarize long PDFs
- Search across multiple documents
- Find relevant information without manually reading every page

Spend less time searching and more time understanding.

## Supported File Types

Bring your documents together in one private workspace.

- 📄 PDF documents
- 📝 TXT text files
- 📘 Markdown (.md) files

Import your files and start exploring your knowledge with AI.

## 100% Offline AI — Privacy First

Your documents contain your knowledge. They should stay under your control.

Unlike cloud-based AI document assistants, Note Vault is designed to process your documents directly on your device.

- 🔒 No cloud AI processing
- 📵 No internet required after setup
- ☁️ No cloud document storage
- 📤 No document uploads to AI servers
- 👤 No user account required
- 🛡️ No analytics tracking

Your documents stay on your device while you use supported local AI features.

## Intelligent Document Q&A With Local RAG

Note Vault uses a local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to help you find answers inside your documents.

Here's how it works:

1. **Process locally:** Your documents are prepared on your device.
2. **Retrieve relevant content:** The system finds passages related to your question.
3. **Generate answers:** Your local AI model uses the retrieved content to formulate a response.

The result is a smarter way to explore documents, with answers grounded in relevant source material.

## Built for Mobile AI

Note Vault brings edge AI directly to your phone, reducing dependence on remote AI infrastructure.

- Lightweight AI models
- ARM CPU inference optimization

show_hn.title: Show HN: EdgeDox – Offline document AI on Android using Qwen3.5-0.8B

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve been experimenting with running small language models directly on mobile devices and built a small Android app called EdgeDox.

The idea was to make document AI usable without sending files to a cloud service. Many existing tools require uploading PDFs or documents to a server, which can be a privacy concern.

EdgeDox runs a lightweight language model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) locally on the device so documents stay on the phone.

Current features:

• Ask questions about PDFs
• Document summarization
• Extract key points from long documents
• Works completely offline
• No accounts or server processing

The model runs locally using mobile inference (MNN). I'm experimenting with quantized models and other optimizations to keep memory usage and latency reasonable on mid-range Android devices.

Some challenges so far:

• balancing context size with mobile memory limits
• improving response latency on CPU-only devices
• reducing model load time

The project is still in early beta, and I’m mainly looking for feedback from people experimenting with on-device AI or mobile inference.

Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.cyberfly.edgedox
